query:
SELECT 
  ph.cardId,
  c.name,
  COUNT(*) as transactionCount,
  AVG(ph.price) as avgPrice,
  MIN(ph.price) as minPrice,
  MAX(ph.price) as maxPrice,
  MIN(ph.soldAt) as earliestDate,
  MAX(ph.soldAt) as latestDate
FROM price_history ph
JOIN cards c ON ph.cardId = c.id
WHERE ph.cardId IN (210022, 781745, 819562, 150847, 781727, 210012)
  AND ph.grade = 'PSA10'
  AND ph.soldAt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
GROUP BY ph.cardId, c.name
ORDER BY ph.cardId;
